work.author: Anonymous chain letter, forwarded by a named subscriber to the RecipesAndMore mailing list
work.description: The earliest independently archived instance located of the folded-napkin chain email, carrying the claim in its standard wording. Registered as dated evidence of the medium and the date of circulation. The scriptural text quoted inside the email is from a modern copyrighted English version reading folded up, which is where the claim's key word comes from; that version is described in consuming publications rather than reproduced.
